title: Michelin Star Hotels and Restaurants With Rooms in the USA

h1: Michelin Star Hotels and Restaurants With Rooms in the USA
summary: Where you can eat at a starred table in the US and stay the night: every restaurant with rooms or inside a hotel, and how to book a room with dinner.

body:
You can stay the night at {{rooms_usa}} of the United States’ Michelin-starred restaurants: {{roomsHotel_usa}} are inside a hotel and {{roomsOwn_usa}} has rooms of its own. {{rooms3_usa}} hold three stars: SingleThread in Healdsburg, with five rooms above the restaurant, and Addison at the Fairmont Grand Del Mar near San Diego. Checked {{checked}}.

Michelin star hotels are rarer in the US than in Europe. Most American starred restaurants are standalone city restaurants, so fewer than one in ten has somewhere to sleep, against about two in five in France and Italy. Those that do are mostly in big hotels in Las Vegas, New York and Florida, or in resorts and inns in California’s wine country and on its coast. US hotels also rarely publish a price for dinner and a room together: rates show only once you pick dates, and the tasting menu is booked and paid for separately. The tables below give, for each restaurant, its hotel or rooms and any stay package it advertises, from its own or its hotel’s website. For prices at every starred restaurant in the country, see our page of Michelin star restaurants in the US, where “Show › With rooms” picks out these {{rooms_usa}}.

Which US hotels have a Michelin star restaurant?

These are the hotels with Michelin star restaurants in the USA: {{roomsHotel_usa}} starred restaurants inside a hotel you can book. Of the Michelin star hotels in the USA, Las Vegas has the most, {{rooms_las_vegas}}, all on the Strip: Joël Robuchon’s two restaurants at the MGM Grand, Restaurant Guy Savoy at Caesars Palace and é by José Andrés, a nine-seat counter inside The Cosmopolitan. In New York, Jean-Georges is at the Trump International Hotel at Columbus Circle and Le Coucou at 11 Howard in SoHo. In Florida, Victoria & Albert’s is at Disney’s Grand Floridian, The Surf Club Restaurant at the Four Seasons at The Surf Club and the Chef’s Counter at MAASS at the Four Seasons in Fort Lauderdale. Atlas is at the St. Regis Atlanta, Kappo Kappo at the Austin Proper and Nari at Hotel Kabuki in San Francisco.

{{table:rooms-hotel-usa}}

Which Michelin star restaurants with rooms are in the USA’s wine country?

The Michelin star restaurants with rooms in the USA that feel most like a European restaurant with rooms are in the country. In California, SingleThread’s five rooms come with a table guaranteed, Harbor House Inn on the Mendocino coast holds a few tables for guests in its eleven rooms and cottages, and Aubergine is at the 20-room L’Auberge Carmel. In Napa Valley, Auberge du Soleil has 50 rooms on the hillside above Rutherford and Auro is at the Four Seasons in Calistoga; further south, The Restaurant at JUSTIN is at the JUST Inn on a Paso Robles winery and Caruso’s at Rosewood Miramar Beach in Montecito. In Virginia, The Inn at Little Washington has 24 rooms and suites in the main building and nearby houses.

{{table:rooms-usa}}

Do US Michelin star hotels sell dinner and a room together?

A few do, though none publishes the price online. The Inn at Little Washington sells a night with dinner in its starred dining room, a full breakfast, tax and service in one package, from Wednesday to Sunday. Auberge du Soleil offers a two-night romance package with the six-course tasting menu, and a midweek room rate with a $150 credit towards dinner in The Restaurant. At SingleThread and Harbor House, booking a room is itself the surest way to a table, as both hold dinner for their guests.

How to book a stay at a Michelin star restaurant in the US

Book the room on the hotel’s or inn’s own website, then the table: in the US they are almost always separate bookings, and the tasting menu is often a prepaid ticket on Tock or Resy. Ask the hotel’s concierge if the restaurant is full, as hotel guests sometimes get first call. Expect hotel and sales tax, and in Las Vegas and many resorts a nightly resort fee, on top of the room rate. Several of the wine-country resorts and the Florida beach hotels have minimum stays at weekends and in high season.
